description: The NIL threshold at s.393(1) [Table: Sl. No. 6(iii)] col. D, '(ii) for (c) of Col. B: Nil.' A director's sitting fee of 1,000 attracts deduction, where the SAME 10% rate under 6(iii)(b) professional services would not until 50,000. This is the fixture that pins the difference between the two codes being a real one: 1,000 x 10% = 100. Hand-computed. A threshold of zero with the strict 'exceeds' test means any positive sum is deducted upon.
